A repository received as a folder can name filter drivers, a signing program, core.fsmonitor, sshCommand or a credential helper, which would run with the user's rights. Narrowed to settings, since MELLON-VER-SRS-131 covers hooks. Mellon is assumed to run none of these today; confirm. Answered on 2026-11-11 (Q-V2), to confirm.
object.description: Mellon shall not run a program that the repository's git settings name.
